semantics.street: One Jack action-turn and one move-track slot between numbered circles connected through an unoccupied crossing or direct chain of crossings, matching mapData.ts.
semantics.investigator: One graph step between crossings sharing a numbered circle or connected directly; an investigator turn permits 0, 1, or 2 such steps.
semantics.coach: One Jack action-turn, two recorded locations, and two move-track slots. It ignores occupied crossings. Intermediate and final circles must be non-blue and distinct from each other and the origin.
semantics.alleyBoat: One Jack action-turn and one move-track slot; at most two of each per game.
semantics.discoverySpecialEntry: Tour profiles require the first arrival at each next discovery to be a normal street move. Coach use of that target as intermediate or final is excluded. Other as-yet-unreached discovery circles are not target-specifically forbidden inside a pairwise leg, so special-tour set results are a topology/planning lower bound when a route touches a third discovery early.
semantics.blockedVsStatic: All ordinary distances are on the unoccupied static map. Blockade results rebuild street reachability after deleting the specified occupied crossings. Coach is not included in blockade paths because Coach ignores investigators.

websiteDifficultyComparison.caveat: The site's hand-entered cost matrix includes half steps and is not the exact unblocked street graph. Its formula is a heuristic, not a validated win-probability model; published tier gaps intentionally exclude many sets.

discoveryPairSafetyProxies.interpretation: Static lower-bound proxies. Investigators are treated as if they knew the route; clue-search order, inference, occupied-crossing blocking, and simultaneous multi-investigator coordination are not solved.

blockades.searchScope: All three-crossing combinations from boundary-transition incident crossings plus the top 20 investigator betweenness crossings.
